mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.5% indicates accommodative monetary policy, reducing discount rates for equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in >60% of periods when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 5.0% signals labor market deterioration, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 returns are positive in >60% of months when UNRATE exceeds 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and retail sales indicate weakening consumer demand, triggering equity sell-offs and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: Joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative returns (Rank IC < 0.03 over 12-month rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: During supply chain recovery, rising industrial production signals improved manufacturing output, boosting corporate profits and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 returns are negative in >60% of periods when INDPRO growth exceeds 1.0% monthly.

mechanism_narrative: Strong employment growth consistently supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 returns are negative in >60% of months with PAYEMS growth above 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Federal funds rate exceeding 0.5% signals imminent monetary tightening, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 returns are positive in >60% of months when FEDFUNDS exceeds 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in inflation and federal funds rate indicate aggressive monetary policy response, compressing equity valuations and driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: Joint rise in CPIAUCSL and FEDFUNDS fails to predict negative returns (Rank IC < 0.03 over 12-month rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: In post-pandemic recovery, rising retail sales drive corporate revenue growth, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 returns are negative in >60% of periods when RSAFS growth exceeds 0.5% monthly.
